v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Secúndum magnam misericórdiam * tuam miserére mei, Deus.
text.en: Have mercy upon me, O God, * after thy great mercy.

text.la: Si mihi Dóminus * salvátor fúerit, non timébo, quid fáciat mihi homo.
text.en: If the Lord be my Saviour * I will not fear what man can do unto me.

text.la: In velaménto * clamávi valde dilúculo: Deus, Deus meus, ad te de luce vígilo.
text.en: Within the veil I cried betimes: * O God, Thou art my God, early will I seek thee.
Let us sing praises * to the Lord our God.
In the high places, * praise ye God.

text.la: Fratres: Libénter suffértis insipiéntes, cum sitis ipsi sapiéntes: sustinétis enim si quis vos in servitútem rédigit, si quis dévorat, si quis áccipit, si quis extóllitur, si quis in fáciem vos cædit.
text.en: For you gladly suffer the foolish; whereas yourselves are wise. For you suffer if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take from you, if a man be lifted up, if a man strike you on the face.

v.en: Lord, thou hast been our refuge.

text.la: Cum turba * plúrima convenírent ad Iesum, et de civitátibus properárent ad eum, dixit per similitúdinem: Exiit qui séminat, semináre semen suum.
text.en: When much people were gathered together to Jesus, * and were come to Him out of every city, He spoke by a parable: A sower went out to sow his seed.

text.la: Deus, qui cónspicis, quia ex nulla nostra actióne confídimus: concéde propítius; ut, contra advérsa ómnia Doctóris géntium protectióne muniámur.
text.en: O God, Who seest that we put not our trust in anything that we do, mercifully grant that through the protection of the Teacher of the Gentiles we may be defended against all adversity.
